title: Entire solutions of higher order Briot-Bouquet equations
summary: For a meromorphic function $f$ in the complex plane, we determine when $f$ and $f^{(k)}$ are algebraically dependent. This happens precisely when $f$ belongs to the class $W$ of elliptic functions and their degenerates, or satisfies a linear differential equation $f^{(k)} + af + b = 0$ with constant coefficients. The case of functions having a pole was settled previously. We complete the proof by treating entire solutions.
